checks.name: Value is a whole percentage: 15 means 15%
checks.remarks: Between 0 and 1 means a fraction was entered (0.15). Above 1,000 means an amount was entered.

checks.name: The value has a basis from the LTI basis tab

checks.name: Total = sum of the listed components, within the existing tolerance

checks.name: One pay period across all pay fields for the role
checks.remarks: Existing gate.

checks.name: The value is the amount actually paid, with months_in_role set

checks.name: Kept, with token_salary = true

checks.name: is_aggregated = true and aggregate_headcount set

checks.name: months_in_role set
checks.applies_when: Title contains former, interim, acting, until, resigned, appointed, from, since, joined or left
checks.remarks: These are usually part-year roles.

checks.name: Currency is the country's own, or EUR, USD, GBP or CHF

range_notes: Provisional ranges: computed from the first 50 tracker companies (2,584 filled values).
They are NOT Allshares-approved and are NOT published survey data.
Method: min, 5th percentile, median, 95th percentile and max per field and unit. Values are stored in base units.
Money fields are split by currency. Non-currency fields are split by unit (people, employees, shares, % of base salary).
No outliers are removed. Caveats are listed per row.
Sample is small for many rows (n under 10). Treat those ranges as indicative only.
Gate NUM-04 (magnitude in plausible range) stays NOT RUN until Allshares approves ranges. These ranges are not yet applied to scoring.
Known data issues to fix before ranges are used: zero values that may be 'not found', mixed units in revenue (for example SEK), and the non-ISO label 'EURO'.
Next steps: Allshares to confirm or replace each range, and to set ranges for fields not listed here (for example headcount by sector and size).
